room.evidence: Original room selection remains the same for this snapshot.

room_marker.description: A bedroom with a bed flanked by two nightstands, and an office chair in front of an office desk located in the corner of the room. There is no wardrobe in the room.
room_marker.reason: the room is used as authored: nothing is substituted, so nothing is displaced and no prop needs to fall anywhere

human.method: Deterministic original SMPL-X segment generator from recorded betas and axis-angle joint values; no random pose, optimization or simulation; root transform and scale0.9 preserved. Only texture/face UV registration changed.
human.validation_against_retained_original: Recorded pose/betas applied through the same deterministic generator; ACCEPT control reconstruction exactly matched all10 retained source meshes.

robot.other_joint_positions: MuJoCo default qpos0, matching freshly built Genesis renderer without simulation
robot.configure_rotation: +90 degrees world Z, applied by original Stretch.configure
robot.tool: Actual placement-renderer default bathing sphere MJCF, including actual visual sphere; no approximate scratcher substituted.

geometry_policy: No mesh simplification; original room and robot meshes transformed by recorded configuration. Original SMPL-X generated deterministically from recorded parameters. Texture, UV registration and camera are presentation changes only.

web_export.compression: Lossless EXT_meshopt_compression. No quantization or simplification; texture images resized to1024 max.

geometry_verification.positions: SHA256 equality of raw float32 POSITION buffers
geometry_verification.triangles: Identical winding-aware triangle sets (meshopt may cyclically rotate index triples)
